# Keep POP download and message transactions separate

beginMailDelivery owns the folder download lock; the client records _folderLocked after it succeeds and cleanup aborts delivery while that flag is set. Each TOP/RETR message calls incorporateBegin once, streams lines, then calls incorporateComplete or incorporateAbort on failure. Partial TOP messages pass the server-reported size to completion; RETR passes zero. Document and test these two nested lifetimes separately. A successful begin method is void in current IDL, not the historical Boolean return described by older code. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or accessibility session was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: POP delivery and per-message lifecycle.
